subject: ggvis plot not displayed completely when the app is deployed over shinyapps.io

messages.author: f2008c6219f50aeb
messages.subject: ggvis plot not displayed completely when the app is deployed over shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I have a ggvis plot that is displayed properly in R but that is scaled in the app hosted at shinyapps.io in a way that one has to drag the lower right corner to see all the data points along the x axis. Could you please indicated what might be the issue?

Code for the plot (includes a sample data frame):

plotdfN0<-data.frame(cbind(c(1,1,2,2,3,3),c(1,2,1,2,1,2)))
colnames(plotdfN0)<-c("treats","N0")

se <- function(x) sqrt(var(x,na.rm=TRUE)/length(x))
 
plotdf<- plotdfN0 %>% group_by(treats) %>% summarise(N0mean=mean(N0),N0sd=sd(N0),N0se=se(N0))
plotdf$N0sd[which(is.na(plotdf$N0sd))]<-0
plotdf$N0se[which(is.na(plotdf$N0se))]<-0
plotdf<-rbind(mutate(plotdf,N0sdbar=N0mean-N0sd,N0sebar=N0mean-N0se),
              mutate(plotdf,N0sdbar=N0mean+N0sd,N0sebar=N0mean+N0se))
plotdf<- plotdf %>% select(-N0sd,-N0se) %>% arrange(treats)
plotdf<- left_join(plotdf,plotdfN0)

upperlimit<-round(max(plotdfN0$N0),0)

plotdf %>% ggvis(opacity:=1) %>%
  layer_points(x=~treats,y=~N0mean,shape:="diamond",size:=100) %>%
  group_by(treats) %>%
  layer_paths(x=~treats,y=~N0sdbar,strokeWidth:=3,stroke:="black") %>%
  layer_paths(x=~treats,y=~N0sebar,strokeWidth:=3) %>%
  layer_points(x=~treats,y=~N0,fill:="red",opacity:=1) %>%
  scale_numeric("y", domain = input_slider(min=0,max=upperlimit,value=c(0,upperlimit),label="Set Y-axis range:")) %>%
  add_axis("y",grid=F,title="Hill's N0",title_offset=50,
           properties=axis_props(labels=list(fontSize=14,align="right"),title=list(fontSize=16))
  ) %>%
  add_axis("x",grid=F,title="",properties=axis_props(labels=list(fontSize=14,angle=270,align="right")))

The plot is embedded within the observe function in the app.

Thanks in advance!

Cheers,
Bogdan
